summary: Iteration 111 verifies (1) commission snapshot stored on the order at purchase time, (2) payout cannot exceed remaining balance, (3) staff-chart returns a `profit` series alongside `data`, and (4) admin orders expose manager_id/manager_name so the new /admin/orders manager filter works. Added new backend test file test_iter111_commission_snapshot_payout_limit.py (9/9 passing) and fixed iter110 test (replaced the two payouts of 50 and 20 with amounts within the actual balance, because POST now rejects >balance with HTTP 400). Regression: tests/test_iter110_mgr_orders_payouts_chart.py (14/14) and tests/test_iter109_staff_managers.py (25/25) still pass — 39/39 together. Backend behaviour confirmed via Mongo doc reads (dotenv MONGO_URL/DB_NAME): new orders written by POST /orders of a bound client store manager_commission_percent = individual percent if set else standard percent from PUT /admin/status-conditions; order B created AFTER raising the manager's commission stores the NEW percent while order A keeps the old one (verified both with individual percent 10→20 and with standard percent 5→15). GET /admin/staff/{id}/stats?period=all commission = Σ (profit_i * percent_i) = payouts.earned. Cancelled orders contribute 0 (cancellation via client-owned POST /orders/{id}/cancel; admin cannot call that endpoint). Orders without a saved percent (legacy — e.g. order placed before binding then attached via admin POST /admin/staff/{id}/clients with include_past_orders=true) fall back to the manager's CURRENT percent, verified: manager_id gets back-filled by the binding, manager_commission_percent stays null (not retro-stamped), commission = profit*current_percent. Unbound-client orders have manager_id null AND manager_commission_percent null in Mongo. Payout limit: POST /api/admin/staff/{id}/payouts with amount>balance → 400 with detail 'Выплата больше остатка к выплате (XX.XX ₽)' (Russian + ruble sign); amount==balance succeeds and makes balance exactly 0; any positive payout after → 400; DELETE restores the balance and a new payout becomes possible again; manager with earned=0 → any payout → 400. staff-chart returns {managers, data, profit}: same months, same keys per row, for the TEST_ChartProfit manager (order price 1000 cash, purchase 600) current-month revenue=900 (cash -10%), profit=300 so revenue−profit≈600 (=purchase_cost). GET /admin/orders items carry manager_id (used by UI filter) AND manager_name; unbound orders have manager_id null. UI smoke (admin, /admin/orders): orders-manager-filter present with 33 options starting with 'all' + 'none' + per-manager (with a manager that has orders) — switching to 'none' hides all order-manager-* badges, 'all' restores all 171 badges. /admin/staff: staff-sales-chart renders with chart-metric-switch and buttons chart-metric-revenue + chart-metric-profit; clicking 'Прибыль' changes the panel title from 'Продажи менеджеров по месяцам' → 'Прибыль менеджеров по месяцам' and re-renders bars.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/staff.py _manager_stats line 223-224: per-order percent snapshot correctly used; None -> current fallback matches the spec for legacy orders.

routes/orders.py line 769: manager_commission_percent(...) is an extra DB round-trip per order creation. For bound clients it reads the manager doc + status_conditions. Low volume today, but if order creation is on a hot path consider caching the standard commission per request.
routes/orders.py line 1594-1595 (merge): the merged order keeps manager_id and manager_commission_percent of the NEWEST source order, as specified.

routes/staff.py _payout_summary runs _manager_stats(..., 'all') for EVERY manager inside list_staff — unchanged from iter110, still N+1 for commissions. Because add_payout now reads _payout_summary to enforce the limit, the hot path is one extra pass per payout creation. Fine at current scale, worth watching if staff grows past ~50.
routes/staff.py add_payout uses balance+0.005 float tolerance — matches the frontend check in StaffExtras.js line 61 (same 0.005). Good.

AdminOrdersPage.js line 356/459-462: filter combines with status filter and search correctly; dropdown is populated only with managers that have orders, which is the spec. Verified in UI (33 options, duplicates come from soft-deleted TEST managers still referenced by their past TEST orders — expected).
StaffExtras.js line 61: client-side pre-check also refuses amount>balance+0.005 with a toast before POST — defence in depth with the backend 400.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter110_mgr_orders_payouts_chart.py (TestPayouts.test_payouts_full_flow: amounts 50+20 reduced to within balance ~30 ₽ because POST now enforces amount<=balance; added an explicit over-balance 400 assertion)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (orders-manager-filter, chart-metric-switch, profit title rendering all verified)

seed_data_creation: Per-test TEST_ managers (soft-deleted), TEST_ clients (hard-deleted via /admin/users), TEST_ products (deleted), TEST_ orders (cancelled to restore stock via /orders/{id}/cancel from the client session), TEST_ payouts (soft-cancelled). Status conditions restored to all-zero / manager.commission_percent=0 after the module. Demo manager, user@demo.com and their binding are left untouched. Note: /admin/orders manager-filter dropdown shows ~30 historic TEST_ manager names because soft-deleted managers are still referenced by their past orders; this is the spec (dropdown is populated by orders, not by live managers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep -oP 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=\K\S+' /app/frontend/.env) && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter111_commission_snapshot_payout_limit.py /app/backend/tests/test_iter110_mgr_orders_payouts_chart.py /app/backend/tests/test_iter109_staff_managers.py -p no:xdist -o addopts='-p asyncio --asyncio-mode=auto' -v`. pytest-asyncio is installed; iter111 relies on it (@pytest.mark.asyncio) to read orders directly from Mongo via motor. Payment-method 'cash' applies a -10% site adjustment so for a 1000 ₽ product goods-revenue=900, cost=600, profit=300; use that when expecting values. Chart profit for a manager this month = Σ (goods_i - cost_i). Legacy orders attached by include_past_orders=true back-fill manager_id but NOT manager_commission_percent, so _manager_stats falls back to the current percent — spec-compliant.
